subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw keep subagents limited to AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md and route Token Plan office workflows through plugins/ClawHub unless live MiniMax proof shows a narrow provider bug, or add an explicit subagent skill-inheritance contract?
rationale: The issue mixes a potentially real MiniMax provider/media bug with a request to undo a deliberate subagent context boundary, and source/docs/tests currently support the boundary rather than broad inherited SKILL.md loading.

options.title: Keep boundary and require live provider proof
options.body: Keep AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only subagent bootstrap, live-test MiniMax Token Plan image generation, and fix only the confirmed provider or media-delivery bug in core.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in skill inheritance
options.body: Define a documented opt-in subagent skill contract with focused compatibility/security tests before allowing Token Plan skill context to flow into subagents.

options.title: Route Token Plan office workflows outside core
options.body: Close or narrow the core issue if the remaining PPT/Word/Excel/PDF workflow is better delivered as a plugin or ClawHub skill bundle.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary and require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only subagent bootstrap, live-test MiniMax Token Plan image generation, and fix only the confirmed provider or media-delivery bug in core.

likelyOwner.reason: The central maintainer choice concerns the subagent bootstrap boundary introduced in 56308a71447972b3913e9583d190f9038722d4b2.
